title: The Kinesiological and Scientific Basis of Human Movement and Sport: Golf
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in KNES350.
Restriction: Must be in a major within the SPHL-Kinesiology department; and must have earned a minimum of 90 credits.
Credit only granted for: KNES441 or KNES498A.
Formerly: KNES498A.
Additional information: This course meets at the University of Maryland Golf Course as specified in the course syllabus. For KNES majors, only one course from KNES136 or KNES137 or KNES441 (formerly KNES498A) can apply to the physical activity requirement.
